function describe<T extends { name: string; [key: `tag${string}`]: string }>(item: T): string {
  const name = item["name"];
  const tag = item["tagColor"];
  return `${name.toUpperCase()}:${tag.length}`;
}

function firstAndRename<T extends string[]>(items: T): string {
  const first = items[0];
  items[1] = first.repeat(2);
  return items.join(",");
}

function pair<T extends [number, string]>(tuple: T): string {
  return tuple[1].padStart(tuple[0], "*");
}

class Counter {
  [key: number]: string;
  count = 0;
  remember(): void {
    this[this.count] = `#${this.count}`;
    this["count"] += 1;
  }
}

console.log(describe({ name: "box", tagColor: "red" }));
console.log(firstAndRename(["a", "b", "c"]));
console.log(pair([5, "x"]));
const counter = new Counter();
counter.remember();
counter.remember();
console.log(counter[0], counter[1], counter.count);
